fragments.text: In today's
, I'm going to be talking about microplastics.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 在今天的讲座中，我将谈谈微塑料。

fragments.text: Microplastics are tiny pieces of plastic smaller than

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 微塑料是尺寸小于五毫米的塑料碎片。

fragments.text: Recently there's been a greater awareness that there are
plastic waste – big and small – in the

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 最近，人们越来越意识到，环境中存在着大量大小不等的塑料垃圾。

fragments.text: The amount of plastic waste in the
has received
, but far less is known about the effects of microplastics in freshwater and particularly in

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 海洋中的塑料垃圾数量已受到广泛关注，但人们对淡水中，尤其是土壤中微塑料的影响却知之甚少。

fragments.text: Microplastics can enter the environment via a number of

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 微塑料可通过多种不同来源进入大自然。

fragments.text: Threads and microfibres detach from
every time they're put in a
, and these find their way into the

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 每次将合成纤维衣物放入洗衣机中清洗，丝线和微纤维会从合成纤维衣物上脱落并进入水系统。

fragments.text: Other sources include big pieces of plastic waste that are already in the environment, and these break down into microscopic particles

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 其他来源包括已经存在于自然中的大块塑料废弃物，这些废弃物在一段时间后会分解成微小颗粒。

fragments.text: On a larger scale, factory waste is another route, as are tyres which wear down as cars, lorries and so on travel along

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 在更大范围内，工厂废料是另一个来源，汽车、卡车等在路面上行驶时受到磨损的轮胎也是一个来源。

fragments.text: We already understand some of the impacts of microplastics from studies involving fish and other animals.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 通过对鱼类和其他动物的研究，我们已经了解了微塑料的一些影响。

fragments.text: There is
that microplastics harm small creatures in a variety of ways, such as by damaging their mouths, or by impairing their ability to feed, for example when microplastics get lodged in their

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 有证据表明，微塑料会以各种方式对小型生物造成伤害，例如损坏它们的口腔，或损害它们的进食能力，如当微塑料卡在它们的消化系统中时。

fragments.text: , it is likely that humans consume microplastics, as these have been detected in a wide range of food and drink products, including bottled water, as well as in water that comes direct from the

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 令人吃惊的是，人类很可能也食用微塑料，因为在各种食物和饮品（包括瓶装水和自来水）中都检测到了微塑料。

fragments.text: What's more, salt and many kinds of
have also been found to contain microplastics.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 此外，盐和多种海产品也被发现含有微塑料。

fragments.text: However, it's important to underline that there is not yet
that microplastics cause significant
to people.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 不过，必须强调的是，目前还没有确凿证据证明微塑料会对人体造成重大伤害。

fragments.text: In many countries, including here in the UK, there is
which prevents
from adding plastic microbeads to shower
, facial cleansers and toothpaste.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 包括英国在内的许多国家都有法律禁止制造商在沐浴露、洁面乳和牙膏中添加塑料微珠。

fragments.text: It is very difficult to accurately
the total amount of microplastic particles in the soil as they can be hard to detect, but we do know they are carried in the air and deposited in the soil by

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 要准确估计土壤中的微塑料颗粒总量非常困难，因为它们很难被检测到，但我们确实知道这些颗粒被空气携带，并通过降雨沉积在土壤中。

fragments.text: What's more, many of the
used by both farmers and
contain microplastics.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 此外，农民和园丁使用的许多肥料都含有微塑料。

fragments.text: A team from the Anglia Ruskin University in Cambridge has carried out a study of the effects of microplastics on the digestive tracts of

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 剑桥安格利亚鲁斯金大学的一个研究小组对微塑料对蚯蚓消化道的影响进行了研究。

fragments.text: These worms, which live in topsoil, are an essential component of our

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 这些生活在表土中的蚯蚓是我们农业系统的重要组成部分。

fragments.text: By
, they mix nutrients into it, thereby making it more fertile.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 它们以土壤为食，将养分混合到土壤中，从而使土壤更加肥沃。

fragments.text: The researchers set out to discover whether the introduction of microplastics into the soil – and the subsequent ingestion of these by earthworms – would impact soil quality and ultimately inhibit plant growth.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 研究人员试图探究，将微塑料引入土壤中——以及蚯蚓随后摄入这些微塑料——是否会影响土壤质量并最终抑制植物生长。

fragments.text: The short answer was, yes, it did.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 简单来说：会。

fragments.text: After placing three different types of microplastic particles into the soil, they planted perennial rye

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 将三种不同类型的微塑料颗粒放入土壤后，他们种植了多年生黑麦草。

fragments.text: The particles of microplastic, which included biodegradable PLA and conventional high-density polyethylene, or HDPE, were then ingested by the earthworms in the soil.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 这些包括可生物降解的聚乳酸 (PLA) 和传统的高密度聚乙烯 (HDPE) 微塑料颗粒随后被土壤中的蚯蚓摄入。

fragments.text: The result was that the worms
rapidly.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 结果，蚯蚓的体重迅速下降。

fragments.text: What's more, a
than normal of the rye grass seeds germinated, and the researchers concluded that this was a direct result of the earthworms being unable to fulfil their normal role in making soil more fertile.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 此外，黑麦草种子的发芽率也低于正常水平。研究人员得出结论，这是蚯蚓无法发挥其正常作用让土壤变得更加肥沃所导致的结果。

fragments.text: The team also discovered that there was an increase in the amount of
found in the soil, and this was attributed mainly to the microplastic particles from conventional HDPE plastic.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 研究小组还发现，土壤中的酸含量有所增加，这主要归因于传统高密度聚乙烯塑料中的微塑料颗粒。

fragments.text: The conclusions of the study make for very interesting reading – I've included the reference in the notes to give you at the end of this

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 这项研究的结论是非常有趣——我在本节课结束会给大家的笔记中附上了参考文献。

fragments.text: To summarise, the authors proposed the idea that we need to regard soil as we would regard any other
in nature.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 概括一下，作者提出的观点是，我们需要像看待自然界中的任何其他过程一样看待土壤。

fragments.text: This means we should accept the implications of soil being dependent on decaying and dead matter constantly being passed through the bodies of earthworms.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 这意味着我们应该接受“土壤的肥沃依赖于蚯蚓体内不断传递的腐烂和死亡物质”这一自然现象将会带来的影响。

fragments.text: That is, when soil becomes impoverished by the presence of microplastics, not only
but also the whole of
are negatively impacted.

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.translation: 也就是说，当土壤因为微塑料的存在而变得贫瘠时，不仅生态系统，整个社会都会受到负面影响。

title: 微塑料对环境的影响 (Microplastics and environment)
